summary: Phase 3 backend fully validated. 42/42 pytest tests pass (13 pre-existing gate/index tests + 29 new integration tests hitting the running preview API + real MongoDB). Golden-set LLM harness ran 10 fixtures @ 98.95% accuracy (target 95%, passed_target=true). All Founder Directives #1-#9 exercised: internal ingest 401/403 semantics + 503 code path, submission_receipts immutability (no mutation calls in service), 14-gate enumeration in exact spec order, authorization_scope always pass with 'Interface only in Phase 3' detail, gate parity coverage-preview vs feed, feed passport_not_activated gate, link-import 409 for linkedin/indeed/handshake + 201 derived for greenhouse, duplicate ingest resiliency + direct Mongo DuplicateKeyError, shortlist duplicate protection (409 already_shortlisted), atomic state transitions with 200/409/400 semantics, match_scores read + feedback, usage_meter only counts NEW scores, Idempotency-Key replay on shortlist AND state PATCH (X-Idempotent-Replay:true, byte-identical body, single row inserted), 15 SampleCo sample_jobs with complete requirements payload, llm_costs collection has 20 rows with all required fields including user_id.
critical_code_review_comments: internal_router.py correctly ordering: 503 (no token configured) checked BEFORE 401 (missing header) and 403 (wrong header) — matches Founder Directive #1 exactly.
applications/repository.atomic_transition uses find_one_and_update with expected-state precondition — no read-modify-write race window. Correct implementation of Founder Directive #4.

core/db.py partial unique index on applications is well-formed (partialFilterExpression enumerates OPEN_STATES, since Mongo partial indexes don't support $ne). Closed apps correctly excluded so a user can re-apply after closing.
gate_engine.py has authorization_scope hard-coded to 'pass' with the exact required detail string ('Interface only in Phase 3. Enforced at submit-time (lands with Phase 5).') — parity contract holds.

match_scores.upsert() returns bool for was_new; feed calls increment_jobs_processed only when scored_new_count > 0 — usage_meter cannot inflate via repeated feed calls. Verified empirically in test_usage_meter_increments_only_for_new_scores.
services/llm.py logs a cost row on BOTH success and failure attempts (2 _write_cost_row calls per parse attempt path). documents/service.py correctly passes user_id into parse_resume_text.
submission_receipts/service.py has zero mutation calls (asserted by test_submission_receipts_service_has_no_update_or_delete). Application-layer immutability enforced.

OpenAPI parameter names differ from spec text but structurally identical — spec says /api/v1/jobs/{id} but actual is /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}. Test updated to use the actual parameter names; this is not a bug, just a minor spec/impl doc drift.

Minor observation: user_import canonical_key uses `import::{user_id}::{uuid}` format which correctly satisfies canonical_key regex, but if two users import the exact same URL there'll be two derived rows. Acceptable in v0.1 since resolver ties them later.
Idempotency middleware works cleanly for both POST /shortlist (201) and PATCH /state (200) — both replays return byte-identical body and X-Idempotent-Replay:true. No duplicate DB rows created.

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 6 ephemeral qatest.com::qa-* jobs and 3 greenhouse imports during ingest + import tests. Seeded one direct match_scores row for User Zero on sample_job[0] to exercise GET/feedback endpoints when natural feed produces no passing rows (User Zero has no approved skill/education claims in seed → gates return UNKNOWN → nothing passes). This is expected behavior per Phase 2 seeding rules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Phase 3 backend is fully green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_integration.py is the regression suite. Run with: `cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests -v`. Golden-set harness (real GPT-5 calls, ~30s + $ cost): `cd /app/backend && python3 -m tests.golden_resumes.golden_run`. NOTE: User Zero's seeded claims start as pending — feed passing[] will be empty until at least one identity claim and one education/employment claim are approved (via admin console or /api/v1/claims/{id}/approve). The match_score test uses a direct Mongo insert to work around this. If a future test needs feed.passing to be non-empty for User Zero, approve those claims first. Frontend not exercised per Founder Directive #9.
